description: Header file defining the OStringStream class, a custom string stream implementation optimized for appending to a user-specified std::string, part of the Abseil C++ library.

classes.name: OStringStream
classes.description: A custom string stream class that appends to a user-specified std::string, designed for performance improvements over std::ostringstream.

classes.name: OStringStream::Streambuf
classes.description: A nested stream buffer class used internally by OStringStream to manage string output.

methods.name: OStringStream::str
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the internal std::string used by the stream.

methods.name: OStringStream::str (const version)
methods.description: Returns a const pointer to the internal std::string used by the stream.

methods.name: OStringStream::str (setter)
methods.description: Sets the internal std::string to which the stream appends.

methods.name: OStringStream::overflow
methods.description: Handles overflow in the stream buffer (implementation not shown).

methods.name: OStringStream::xsputn
methods.description: Writes a sequence of characters to the stream buffer (implementation not shown).
